record.content: Terminal Geyser Trail starts at Warner Valley Trailhead and is 5.8 miles round trip. It follows the PCT to a y-junction serving Dream Lake, Devils Kitchen, and a horse trail, then veers left toward Boiling Springs Lake. A second y-junction is at 0.9 mile, followed by a signed three-way junction southeast of Boiling Springs Lake. At 2.5 miles the route rejoins the PCT; about 25 feet later another junction sends the PCT toward Little Willow Lake while the Terminal Geyser route continues ahead.
